en.s: The Battle of Zama was fought in 202 BC in what is now Tunisia between a Roman army commanded by Scipio Africanus and a Carthaginian army commanded by Hannibal. The battle was part of the Second Punic War and resulted in such a severe defeat for the Carthaginians that they capitulated, while Hannibal was forced into exile.

zh.s: 扎马战役于公元前202年在今突尼斯境内进行，交战双方为西庇阿·阿非利加努斯指挥的罗马军队，与汉尼拔指挥的迦太基军队。此战是第二次布匿战争的一部分。迦太基人遭受惨败，被迫投降，汉尼拔则被迫流亡。

en.s: The Battle of Carthage of 439 was when the city of Carthage was captured by the Vandals from the Western Roman Empire on 19 October 439. Under their leader Genseric, the Vandals crossed the Strait of Gibraltar into Africa and captured Hippo Regius in August 431, which they made the capital of their kingdom. Despite an uneasy peace with the Romans, Genseric made a surprise attack against Carthage in October 439.

zh.s: 439年迦太基之战指的是汪达尔人于439年10月19日从西罗马帝国手中攻占迦太基。汪达尔人在首领盖萨里克率领下，渡过直布罗陀海峡进入非洲，并于431年8月攻占希波雷吉乌斯，将其设为王国首都。尽管与罗马人维持着脆弱的和平，盖萨里克仍于439年10月突袭了迦太基。

en.s: The third siege of Pontevico was fought between 16 and 19 October 1453 at Pontevico (Lombardy) between the armies of the Duchy of Milan and that of Republic of Venice, an episode of the Wars in Lombardy.

zh.t: 第三次蓬泰维科围城战
zh.s: 第三次蓬泰维科围城战于1453年10月16日至19日在伦巴第的蓬泰维科进行，交战双方为米兰公国和威尼斯共和国的军队。这是伦巴第战争中的一次战事。

en.s: The siege of Bordeaux by King Charles VII, between August and October 1453, is part of the third phase of the Hundred Years' War. It marks the attachment of the city to the crown of France and the end of the English presence in Guyenne as well as in France and of the Hundred Years' War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 查理七世国王于1453年8月至10月围攻波尔多，这是百年战争第三阶段的一部分。此次围城标志着波尔多归属法国王室、英国在吉耶讷乃至法国的存在终结，以及百年战争结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Lancastrian War was the third and final phase of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. It lasted from 1415, when Henry V of England invaded Normandy, to 1453, when the English were definitively defeated in Aquitaine. It followed a long period of peace from the end of the Caroline War in 1389.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 百年战争的兰开斯特阶段（1415—1453年）
zh.s: 兰开斯特战争是英法百年战争的第三个、也是最后一个阶段。它始于1415年英格兰国王亨利五世入侵诺曼底，终于1453年英军在阿基坦遭到决定性失败。在此之前，自1389年卡罗琳战争结束后，两国曾经历一段长期和平。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Peace of Thorn or Toruń of 1466, also known as the Second Peace of Thorn or Toruń (German: Zweiter Friede von Thorn; Polish: drugi pokój toruński), was a peace treaty signed in the Hanseatic city of Thorn (Toruń) on 19 October 1466 between the Polish king Casimir IV Jagiellon and the Teutonic Knights, which ended the Thirteen Years' War, the longest of the Polish–Teutonic Wars.

zh.s: 1466年《托伦和约》又称《第二次托伦和约》，由波兰国王卡齐米日四世·雅盖隆与条顿骑士团于1466年10月19日在汉萨城市托伦签署。该和约结束了十三年战争，这是波兰与条顿骑士团之间持续时间最长的一场战争。

en.s: The siege of Metz during the Italian War of 1551–59 lasted from 19 October 1552 to 2 January 1553. The so-called Augsburg Interim came to an end when Protestant princes of the Schmalkaldic League approached Henry II of France and concluded the Treaty of Chambord, giving the free cities of Toul, Verdun, and Metz (the 'Three Bishoprics') to the Kingdom of France.

zh.s: 1551—1559年意大利战争期间的梅斯围城战，从1552年10月19日持续至1553年1月2日。施马尔卡尔登联盟的新教诸侯与法国国王亨利二世接洽，缔结《香波尔条约》，将图勒、凡尔登和梅斯这三座自由城市，即“三主教区”，交给法兰西王国，所谓的《奥格斯堡临时敕令》由此走向终结。

en.t: James VI of Scotland is celebrated as an adult ruler by a festival in Edinburgh
en.s: James VI and I (James Charles Stuart; 19 June 1566 – 27 March 1625) was King of Scotland as James VI from 24 July 1567, and King of England and Ireland as James I from the union of the Scottish and English crowns on 24 March 1603, until his death in 1625.

zh.t: 爱丁堡举行庆典，庆祝苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世成年亲政
zh.s: 詹姆斯六世及一世，本名詹姆斯·查尔斯·斯图亚特，生于1566年6月19日，卒于1625年3月27日。他于1567年7月24日起以詹姆斯六世之名担任苏格兰国王，并在1603年3月24日苏格兰与英格兰王位合一后，以詹姆斯一世之名兼任英格兰和爱尔兰国王，直至1625年去世。

en.s: The Capture of Enschede took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War on the 18 and 19 October 1597. A Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange took the city after a very short siege during which they threatened to the Governor that they would destroy the city. The siege was part of Maurice's campaign of 1597, a successful offensive against the Spaniards during what the Dutch call the Ten Glory Years. After the siege and capture of Bredevoort a part of Maurice's army which included Scots and Frisians under Count Solms and Van Duivenvoorde went from Winterswijk to Gronau.

zh.s: 1597年10月18日至19日，八十年战争和英西战争期间，奥兰治的毛里茨率领荷兰与英国联军攻占了恩斯赫德。围城持续的时间很短，联军曾威胁守将要摧毁城市。这场围城是毛里茨1597年对西班牙军队发动的一系列成功攻势的一部分，当时正值荷兰人所称的“辉煌十年”。围攻并攻占布雷德福特后，毛里茨麾下的一部分军队从温特斯韦克前往格罗瑙，其中包括由索尔姆斯伯爵和范·杜伊文福尔德指挥的苏格兰人与弗里斯兰人。

en.s: The siege of Tiverton took place in October 1645 during the First English Civil War, when a Royalist garrison surrendered to a detachment of the New Model Army. Defeats at Naseby in June, and Langport in July destroyed the Royalist field armies, leaving them confined to parts of the West Country, and isolated strongpoints elsewhere. When Bristol surrendered on 10 September, their last significant position was the port of Exeter.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒂弗顿围城战发生在1645年10月的第一次英国内战期间，保王党守军向新模范军的一支分遣部队投降。6月内斯比之败和7月兰波特之败摧毁了保王党的野战军，使其只能据守英格兰西部部分地区，以及其他地方的孤立据点。布里斯托尔于9月10日投降后，他们最后一个重要据点是埃克塞特港。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Raid on Santiago de Cuba took place on 19 October 1662 during the Anglo-Spanish War on the Spanish colony of Cuba. In fear of a Spanish attack on Jamaica, the governor Thomas Hickman-Windsor gaver orders to Royal Navy captain Christopher Myngs to launch a preemptive attack. Myngs' force of fourteen vessels, carrying around 1,400 buccaneers sortied from Port Royal and assaulted Santiago de Cuba.

zh.s: 圣地亚哥-德古巴袭击战于1662年10月19日发生在英西战争期间，目标是西班牙殖民地古巴。牙买加总督托马斯·希克曼-温莎担心西班牙进攻牙买加，命令皇家海军舰长克里斯托弗·明斯先发制人。明斯率领十四艘船，搭载约1,400名海盗，从皇家港出发，袭击了圣地亚哥-德古巴。

en.s: The Siege of Barcelona took place between 14 September and 19 October 1705 during the War of the Spanish Succession when a multinational Grand Alliance army led by Lord Peterborough, supporting the Habsburg pretender to the Spanish throne, captured the city of Barcelona from its Franco-Spanish Bourbonic defenders. An attempted landing had been repulsed the previous year at the Battle of Barcelona (1704). Following the city's capture by Peterborough, the French and Spanish launched a concerted attempt to recapture it the following year during the Siege of Barcelona (1706), which failed. The city and entire Catalonia remained in Allied hands until 1714.

zh.s: 1705年9月14日至10月19日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，彼得伯勒勋爵率领由多国部队组成的大同盟军，支持哈布斯堡家族的西班牙王位争夺者，从效忠波旁王朝的法国和西班牙守军手中夺取了巴塞罗那。前一年，大同盟的登陆尝试曾在1704年的巴塞罗那战役中被击退。彼得伯勒夺城后，法国和西班牙在次年的1706年巴塞罗那围城战中联手试图收复该城，但未能成功。巴塞罗那及整个加泰罗尼亚一直由同盟军控制，直到1714年。

en.s: The siege of Bouchain (1 October – 19 October 1712), was a siege of the War of the Spanish Succession, and a victory for the French troops of the Duc de Villars. A French army of 20,000 men besieged and captured the Allied-controlled fortifications after an 18-day siege, with the 2,000-strong Dutch-Imperial garrison under Major-General Frederik Sirtema van Grovestins capitulating on 19 October.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 布尚围城战于1712年10月1日至19日进行，是西班牙王位继承战争中的一次围城战，由维拉尔公爵的法国军队获胜。两万名法军围攻并在十八天后夺取了同盟军控制的防御工事。弗雷德里克·西尔特马·范·赫罗弗斯廷斯少将指挥的两千名荷兰与帝国守军于10月19日投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Windward Passage was a small naval action between French and British fleets that occurred on 17 to 19 October 1760 during the Seven Years' War. The action took place in the Caribbean between Cap-Français and Eastern Cuba and resulted in a British victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 向风海峡海战是七年战争期间英法舰队之间的一场小规模海战，发生于1760年10月17日至19日。战斗地点在加勒比海的法兰西角与古巴东部之间，最终以英国获胜告终。

en.s: The siege of Pondicherry was the first military action on the Indian subcontinent following the declaration of war between Great Britain and France in the American Revolutionary War. A British force besieged the French Indian port of Pondicherry in August 1778, which capitulated after ten weeks of siege.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 本地治里围城战是美国独立战争期间英法宣战后，印度次大陆上的首次军事行动。1778年8月，一支英军围攻法属印度港口本地治里。该港口在遭到十周围攻后投降。

en.s: The Battle of Klock's Field was an engagement during the American Revolutionary War in the Mohawk Valley region of New York between British and Loyalist forces led by Lieutenant Colonel Sir John Johnson, and New York militia and levies led by Brigadier General Robert Van Rensselaer. The battle occurred on the north side of the Mohawk River in what is now St. Johnsville in Montgomery County.

zh.s: 克洛克田野战役是美国独立战争期间发生在纽约州莫霍克河谷的一场战斗，交战双方为约翰·约翰逊爵士中校率领的英军及效忠派部队，与罗伯特·范·伦斯勒准将率领的纽约民兵及征召部队。战斗地点在莫霍克河北岸，即今天蒙哥马利县的圣约翰斯维尔。

en.s: The Siege of Yorktown, also known as the Battle of Yorktown and the surrender at Yorktown, took place in 1781 and was the final major land engagement of the American Revolutionary War. It was won decisively by the Continental Army, led by George Washington, with support from the Marquis de Lafayette and French Army troops, led by Comte de Rochambeau, and a French Navy force commanded by the Comte de Grasse, defeating the British Army commanded by British Lieutenant General Charles Cornwallis.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 约克镇围城战又称约克镇战役或约克镇受降，发生于1781年，是美国独立战争中最后一场重大地面交战。乔治·华盛顿率领的大陆军，在拉法耶特侯爵、罗尚博伯爵指挥的法国陆军，以及德格拉斯伯爵指挥的法国海军支援下，决定性地击败了英国中将查尔斯·康沃利斯指挥的英军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Treaty of Drottningholm (1791) was a treaty signed between Sweden and Russia on the 19th of October 1791, which aimed to establish a long lasting peace and also acting as an alliance between them against Revolutionary France.
en.n: Treaty of Drottningholm, between Sweden and Russia

zh.s: 《德罗特宁霍尔姆条约》由瑞典与俄罗斯于1791年10月19日签署，旨在建立持久和平，并使两国结成反对革命法国的同盟。
zh.n: 瑞典与俄罗斯签署《德罗特宁霍尔姆条约》。

en.s: The Battle of Puiflijk occurred on 19 October 1794 in the Land van Maas en Waal region of the Netherlands during the Flanders campaign of the War of the First Coalition against Revolutionary France. The battle took place in three different locations between French troops under the command of general Jean-Charles Pichegru and Coalition forces.

zh.s: 珀伊夫莱克战役于1794年10月19日发生在荷兰马斯河与瓦尔河之间的地区，是第一次反法同盟战争中佛兰德斯战役的一部分，当时同盟各国正与革命法国作战。战斗在三个不同地点展开，交战双方是让-夏尔·皮舍格吕将军指挥的法国军队与同盟军。

en.s: At the Battle of Emmendingen, on 19 October 1796, the French Army of Rhin-et-Moselle under Jean Victor Marie Moreau fought the First Coalition Army of the Upper Rhine commanded by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen. Emmendingen is located on the Elz River in Baden-Württemberg, Germany, 9 miles (14 km) north of Freiburg im Breisgau. The action occurred during the War of the First Coalition, the first phase of the larger French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 1796年10月19日，埃门丁根战役爆发，让·维克托·马里·莫罗率领的法国莱茵-摩泽尔军团，与泰申公爵卡尔大公指挥的第一次反法同盟上莱茵军团交战。埃门丁根位于德国巴登-符腾堡州的埃尔茨河畔，在布赖斯高地区弗赖堡以北9英里（14公里）处。这场战役发生于第一次反法同盟战争期间，属于更大规模的法国革命战争的第一阶段。

en.s: The siege of Delhi (8–19 October 1804) was conducted by the Maratha leader Maharaja Yashwantrao Holkar against the forces of the British East India Company, who were assisting the Mughals in defending Delhi during the Second Anglo-Maratha War. Holkar's main political objective was to bring the Mughal emperor under his control and thus with force of 60,000 cavalry and 15,000 infantry, Holkar confronted the British commanders Lt. Col.s Ochterlony and Burn who were in charge at Delhi.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1804年10月8日至19日，马拉塔领袖亚什万特拉奥·霍尔卡尔大君围攻德里，进攻英国东印度公司的军队。第二次英马战争期间，东印度公司正协助莫卧儿王朝保卫德里。霍尔卡尔的主要政治目标是控制莫卧儿皇帝，因此率领六万骑兵和一万五千步兵，与负责驻守德里的英国指挥官奥克特洛尼中校和伯恩中校对抗。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: French emperor Napoleon Bonaparte's Grande Armée occupied Moscow from 14 September to 19 October 1812 during the Napoleonic Wars. It marked the summit of the French invasion of Russia. During the occupation, which lasted 36 days, the city was devastated by fire and looted by both Russian peasants and the French. Napoleon's invasion of Russia began on the 24th of June in 1812, and he had made considerable progress by autumn.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，法国皇帝拿破仑·波拿巴的大军团于1812年9月14日至10月19日占领莫斯科，标志着法国入侵俄国的攻势达到顶点。在持续36天的占领期间，城市遭大火破坏，并受到俄国农民和法国人的劫掠。拿破仑于1812年6月24日开始入侵俄国，到秋季已取得显著进展。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Leipzig, also known as the Battle of the Nations, was fought from 16 to 19 October 1813 at Leipzig, Saxony. The Coalition armies of Austria, Prussia, Sweden, and Russia, led by Tsar Alexander I, Karl von Schwarzenberg, Gebhard von Blücher and Swedish Crown Prince Charles John, decisively defeated the Grande Armée of French Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱比锡战役又称民族会战，于1813年10月16日至19日在萨克森的莱比锡进行。沙皇亚历山大一世、卡尔·冯·施瓦岑贝格、格布哈德·冯·布吕歇尔和瑞典王储卡尔·约翰领导的奥地利、普鲁士、瑞典及俄罗斯同盟军，决定性地击败了法国皇帝拿破仑·波拿巴的大军团。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Cook's Mills was the last engagement between U.S. and British armies in the Niagara, and the penultimate engagement (followed by the Battle of Malcolm's Mills) on Canadian soil during the War of 1812. After a battle lasting less than an hour, American forces out-maneuvered the British column, and later destroyed all grain found in the mill.

zh.s: 库克磨坊战役是1812年战争中美英两军在尼亚加拉地区的最后一次交战，也是该战争在加拿大土地上的倒数第二场战斗，之后还有马尔科姆磨坊战役。经过不到一小时的战斗，美军在机动中取得优势，迫使英军纵队落于下风，随后销毁了磨坊中发现的全部粮食。

en.s: The Battle of Ibiraocaí (Portuguese: Batalha de Ibiraocaí), (Spanish: Batalla de Ibirocay) was fought between an army of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves and the forces of José Gervasio Artigas commanded by José Antonio Berdún. The Luso-Brazilians were victorious.

zh.s: 伊比拉奥凯战役的交战双方，一方是葡萄牙、巴西和阿尔加维联合王国的军队，另一方是何塞·安东尼奥·贝尔敦指挥、隶属于何塞·赫尔瓦西奥·阿蒂加斯的部队。葡萄牙与巴西一方取得胜利。

en.s: The action of Atlixco, also known as the Atlixco affair, on October 19, 1847, was a U.S. victory late in the Mexican–American War by an American force under General Joseph Lane that defeated the Light Corps of the Mexican Army under General Joaquín Rea and captured their base at Atlixco a week after Lane had driven Rea from his lines and relieved the Siege of Puebla.

zh.s: 阿特利斯科战斗又称阿特利斯科事件，发生于1847年10月19日，是美墨战争后期美军的一次胜利。约瑟夫·莱恩将军率领的美军击败了华金·雷亚将军指挥的墨西哥陆军轻装军团，并攻占其位于阿特利斯科的基地。一周前，莱恩刚将雷亚逐出阵地，解除了普埃布拉之围。

en.s: The Battle of Buckland Mills, also known as The Buckland Races or Chestnut Hill, was fought on October 19, 1863, between Union and Confederate forces in the American Civil War. Union cavalry led by Brig. Gen. Judson Kilpatrick were caught in a Confederate ambush and defeated. Near Buckland Mills, on Broad Run, Confederate cavalry commander Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart, with Maj. Gen. Wade Hampton's cavalry division, were covering Gen. Robert E. Lee's retirement from his defeat at Bristoe to the Rappahannock River. On October 19, they turned on Kilpatrick's pursuing Federal cavalry, while Maj. Gen. Fitzhugh Lee's division charged the Federal flank.

zh.s: 1863年10月19日，美国内战期间，联邦军与邦联军在巴克兰米尔斯交战。这场战斗也称“巴克兰赛跑”或“栗树山战役”。贾德森·基尔帕特里克准将率领的联邦骑兵遭到邦联军伏击并被击败。在布罗德溪沿岸的巴克兰米尔斯附近，邦联骑兵司令J.E.B.斯图亚特少将与韦德·汉普顿少将的骑兵师，正掩护罗伯特·E.李将军在布里斯托失利后向拉帕汉诺克河撤退。10月19日，他们转身迎击追赶而来的基尔帕特里克所部；菲茨休·李少将的骑兵师则冲击联邦军的侧翼。

en.s: The Battle of Cedar Creek, or Battle of Belle Grove, fought October 19, 1864, was the culminating battle of the Valley Campaigns of 1864 during the American Civil War. Confederate Lt. Gen. Jubal Early launched a surprise attack against the encamped army of Union Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan, across Cedar Creek, northeast of Strasburg, Virginia. During the morning fighting, seven Union infantry divisions were forced to fall back and lost numerous prisoners and cannons. Early failed to continue his attack north of Middletown, and Sheridan, dramatically riding to the battlefield from Winchester, was able to rally his troops to hold a new defensive line.

zh.s: 1864年10月19日，雪松溪战役（又称贝尔格罗夫战役）将美国内战当年的河谷战役推向高潮。邦联军中将朱巴尔·厄尔利跨过雪松溪，在弗吉尼亚州斯特拉斯堡东北方，突袭了联邦军少将菲利普·谢里登部队的营地。上午的战斗迫使联邦军七个步兵师后撤，大批士兵被俘，许多火炮被夺。厄尔利未能继续向米德尔敦以北推进，而谢里登从温切斯特策马赶到战场，重新集结部队，守住了新的防线。

en.s: The Second Battle of Lexington was a minor skirmish during the American Civil War, taking place on October 19, 1864, in Lexington, the county seat of Lafayette County, Missouri. It formed a part of Confederate Maj. Gen. Sterling Price's Missouri Expedition of that year, and led in turn to the Battle of Little Blue River two days later.Like the first Battle of Lexington, fought in September 1861, this engagement resulted in a Confederate victory. Its overall importance, however, was not nearly so marked as the first battle, which had cemented Southern control of the Missouri Valley and significantly raised Confederate morale in the region.

zh.s: 第二次列克星敦战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模交战，1864年10月19日发生于密苏里州拉斐特县县治列克星敦。它是邦联少将斯特林·普赖斯当年进军密苏里的军事行动的一部分，并引出了两天后的小蓝河战役。与1861年9月的第一次列克星敦战役一样，此战以邦联获胜告终。但它的整体影响远不及第一次战役；第一次战役巩固了南方对密苏里河谷的控制，并显著提振了当地邦联军的士气。

en.s: The St. Albans Raid was the northernmost land action of the American Civil War. It was a controversial raid from Canada by Confederate soldiers meant to rob banks to raise money and to trick the Union Army to divert troops to defend their northern border against further raids. It took place in St. Albans, Vermont, on October 19, 1864.

zh.s: 圣奥尔本斯袭击是美国内战中发生地点最靠北的陆上军事行动。这场颇具争议的袭击由邦联士兵从加拿大出发实施，目的是抢劫银行筹集资金，并诱使联邦军调兵保卫北部边境，以防进一步袭击。事件于1864年10月19日发生在佛蒙特州圣奥尔本斯。

en.s: The First Battle of Ypres (French: Première Bataille des Flandres, German: Erste Flandernschlacht, 19 October – 22 November 1914) was a battle of the First World War, fought on the Western Front around Ypres, in West Flanders, Belgium. en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Greece on October 19, 1933. The president was elected by the Greek Parliament and Senate. Incumbent president Alexandros Zaimis was re-elected and sworn in for his second term the same day. It marked the first time a sitting president had been re-elected and would become the last presidential election of the Second Hellenic Republic before the restoration of the Greek monarchy in 1935.

zh.s: 希腊于1933年10月19日举行总统间接选举，由议会和参议院选出总统。现任总统亚历山德罗斯·扎伊米斯连任，并于当天宣誓开始第二届任期。这是希腊首次有在任总统获得连任，也是1935年恢复君主制前，希腊第二共和国举行的最后一次总统选举。

en.s: The Revolution of 1934, also known as the Revolution of October 1934, or the Revolutionary General Strike of 1934 was a revolutionary strike movement that took place between October 5 and October 19, 1934, during the black biennium of the Second Spanish Republic. The movement was supported by many PSOE and UGT members, notably Largo Caballero and Indalecio Prieto. Most of the events occurred in Catalonia and Asturias. The Revolution began with the Asturian miners' strike of 1934. In Catalonia the revolt was led by the Catalan government, and ended on the 6th of October, after a street battle in Barcelona.

zh.s: 1934年革命又称1934年十月革命或1934年革命总罢工，是1934年10月5日至19日发生的一场革命性罢工运动，当时正值西班牙第二共和国的“黑色两年”。许多西班牙工人社会党（PSOE）和劳动者总联盟（UGT）成员支持这场运动，其中以拉尔戈·卡瓦列罗和因达莱西奥·普列托尤为突出。事件主要发生在加泰罗尼亚和阿斯图里亚斯。革命以1934年阿斯图里亚斯矿工罢工拉开序幕。在加泰罗尼亚，起义由加泰罗尼亚政府领导，10月6日在巴塞罗那的一场巷战后结束。

en.t: 1937 United States Senate special election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1937 Arkansas special senatorial election was held on October 19, 1937, following the death of longtime Democratic senator Joe T. Robinson. Robinson was a powerful senator, staunch Democrat, and strong supporter of United States President Franklin D. Roosevelt, and was instrumental in passing many New Deal programs through the Senate. Arkansas was essentially a one-party state during the Solid South period; the Democratic Party controlled all aspects of state and local office.

en.t: Israeli naval campaign in Operation Yoav
en.s: The Israeli naval campaign in Operation Yoav refers to the operations of the Israeli naval service (later Israel Navy) during Operation Yoav (October 15–22, 1948) in the final stage of the 1948 Arab–Israeli War. The main objective of the naval service was to disrupt the supply lines from Egypt to Palestine, completing the Egyptian expeditionary force's encirclement, and force Egypt to allocate large forces to fight against targets at sea instead of on the ground, where Operation Yoav was conducted.

zh.t: 约阿夫行动中的以色列海军作战
zh.s: 约阿夫行动中的以色列海军作战，指以色列海军部队在1948年阿以战争最后阶段的约阿夫行动（1948年10月15日至22日）中实施的军事行动。该部队后来发展为以色列海军，其主要目标是切断埃及通往巴勒斯坦的补给线，完成对埃及远征军的包围，并迫使埃及将大量兵力调去应对海上目标，减少其用于约阿夫行动所在地面战场的兵力。

en.s: The 1949 FA Charity Shield was the 27th FA Charity Shield, a pre-season exhibition football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup titles. The match took place at Highbury, London, between the league champions Portsmouth and FA Cup winners Wolverhampton Wanderers. The score finished at 1–1, marking the first draw in the Charity Shield and meaning the Shield was shared.

zh.s: 1949年英格兰足总慈善盾是第27届慈善盾比赛，由上赛季甲级联赛冠军与足总杯冠军进行季前表演赛。比赛在伦敦海布里球场举行，对阵双方为联赛冠军朴次茅斯与足总杯冠军伍尔弗汉普顿流浪者。双方最终1比1战平，这是慈善盾历史上首次出现平局，双方因此共享奖盾。

en.s: The Battle of Pyongyang (17–19 October 1950) was one of the major battles of the United Nations' offensive during the Korean War. Following the Battle of Inchon, the UN forces re-captured Seoul, the capital of South Korea, and proceeded to advance into North Korea. Shortly after advancing, the American and South Korean forces faced the North Korean defenses near Pyongyang, the capital of North Korea, on 17 October.

zh.s: 平壤战役于1950年10月17日至19日进行，是朝鲜战争期间联合国军攻势中的主要战役之一。仁川战役后，联合国军重新夺取韩国首都首尔，并继续向朝鲜境内推进。推进后不久，美军与韩军于10月17日在朝鲜首都平壤附近遭遇朝鲜军队的防御。

en.t: Chinese People's Volunteers enter North Korea
en.s: The Chinese People's Volunteers entered North Korea on 19 October 1950 during the Korean War. This entry records their entry into Korea, rather than the outbreak of the war in June or the Chinese offensives that followed.

zh.s: 1950年10月19日，中国人民志愿军进入朝鲜参加朝鲜战争。本条记录的是志愿军入朝这一事件，朝鲜战争于同年6月爆发，此后的志愿军攻势也属于不同阶段。

en.t: Chinese forces capture Chamdo during the Battle of Chamdo
en.s: Chinese forces captured the town of Chamdo in eastern Tibet on October 19, 1950, during the Battle of Chamdo. The fall of the town dealt a decisive blow to Tibetan defenses. Fighting in the wider campaign continued until October 24, so this date records the capture of Chamdo rather than the end of the battle.
en.n: October 19 marks the town’s capture; the wider battle ended on October 24.

zh.s: 1950年10月19日，中国人民解放军在昌都战役中攻占藏东昌都城。昌都失守后，藏军防线瓦解。战役在其他地区仍持续到10月24日；这一天记录的是昌都城被攻占，并非整场战役结束。
zh.n: 10月19日是昌都城被攻占的日期；整个战役到10月24日才结束。

en.s: Operation Polecharge was an offensive undertaken by United Nations Command (UN) forces during the Korean War between 15–19 October 1951, following on from the successful Operation Commando which established the Jamestown Line.

en.s: The Soviet Union did not sign the 1951 Treaty of Peace with Japan, which had re‑established peaceful relations between most other Allied Powers and Japan. On 19 October 1956, Japan and the Soviet Union signed a Joint Declaration providing for the end of the state of war and for the restoration of diplomatic relations between both countries. They also agreed to continue negotiations for a peace treaty.

zh.s: 1951年的《对日和平条约》恢复了日本与大多数其他同盟国之间的和平关系，苏联并未签署该条约。1956年10月19日，日本与苏联签署共同宣言，宣布结束战争状态，恢复两国外交关系。双方还同意继续就缔结和平条约进行谈判。

en.s: The 1957 Scottish League Cup final was the final match of the 1957–58 Scottish League Cup. The football match was played on 19 October 1957 at Hampden Park, in which Celtic beat rivals Rangers in a record 7–1 victory. The final was nicknamed "Hampden in the Sun", a phrase coined by Celtic supporters as the title of a terrace song.

zh.s: 1957年苏格兰联赛杯决赛是1957—1958赛季苏格兰联赛杯的最后一场比赛，于1957年10月19日在汉普顿公园球场举行。凯尔特人以创纪录的7比1击败宿敌流浪者。这场决赛被称为“阳光下的汉普顿”，这个说法由凯尔特人球迷创造，并用作看台助威歌曲的名称。

en.s: Operation Vantage was a British military operation in 1961 to support the newly independent state of Kuwait against territorial claims by its neighbour, Iraq. The UK reacted to a call for protection from Sheikh Abdullah III Al-Salim Al-Sabah of Kuwait, and air, sea and land forces were in place within days. Iraq did not attack and the British forces were replaced by the Arab League.

en.s: The first general election for the Northern Territory Legislative Assembly was held in the Northern Territory on Saturday 19 October 1974, and was won by the Country Liberal Party (CLP), formed a few months earlier from the merger of the territorial Country and Liberal parties. The CLP won 49.01% of the vote, the Australian Labor Party won 30.46% and independent candidates won 20.54%. The Country Liberals took 17 of the 19 assembly seats. The other two were held by independents; Dawn Lawrie won the seat of Nightcliff, and Ron Withnall won the seat of Port Darwin.

zh.s: 北领地立法议会首届大选于1974年10月19日星期六在北领地举行，由乡村自由党（CLP）获胜。该党在数月前由当地的乡村党和自由党合并成立。乡村自由党获得49.01%的选票，澳大利亚工党获得30.46%，独立候选人获得20.54%。乡村自由党赢得议会19个席位中的17席，另外两席由独立人士取得：道恩·劳里赢得奈特克利夫选区，罗恩·威思纳尔赢得达尔文港选区。

en.s: The 1982 United Nations Security Council election was held on 19 October 1982 during the Thirty-seventh session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. The General Assembly elected Malta, the Netherlands, Nicaragua, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe, as the five new non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for two-year mandates commencing on 1 January 1983.

zh.s: 1982年联合国安全理事会选举于10月19日在纽约联合国总部举行，当时正值联合国大会第三十七届会议。大会选出马耳他、荷兰、尼加拉瓜、巴基斯坦和津巴布韦为五个新的安理会非常任理事国，任期两年，自1983年1月1日开始。

en.s: On 19 October 1986, the governmental Tupolev Tu-134 jetliner carrying Mozambican president Samora Machel was on a flight from Mbala, Zambia to the Mozambican capital Maputo, when it crashed 35 nautical miles (65 km) west of its destination, at Mbuzini, South Africa. On board were also 43 other occupants; nine passengers and one crew member survived the crash, but President Machel and 33 others died, including ministers and officials of the Mozambican government. A board of enquiry blamed the captain for failing to react to the Ground Proximity Warning System.

zh.t: 1986年莫桑比克图-134飞机坠毁事件
zh.s: 1986年10月19日，搭载莫桑比克总统萨莫拉·马谢尔的政府图-134喷气客机从赞比亚姆巴拉飞往莫桑比克首都马普托，在目的地以西35海里（65公里）处的南非姆布济尼坠毁。机上除总统外还有43人；九名乘客和一名机组人员生还，马谢尔总统与另外33人遇难，其中包括莫桑比克政府的部长和官员。调查委员会认为，机长未对近地警告系统作出反应，应对事故负责。

en.s: Operation Nimble Archer was the 19 October 1987 attack on two Iranian oil platforms in the Persian Gulf by United States Navy forces. The attack was a response to Iran's missile attack on MV Sea Isle City, a reflagged Kuwaiti oil tanker at anchor off Kuwait, which had occurred three days earlier. The action occurred during Operation Earnest Will, the effort to protect Kuwaiti shipping amid the Iran–Iraq War.

zh.s: “敏捷弓箭手”行动是美国海军于1987年10月19日对波斯湾两座伊朗石油平台发动的袭击。这是对三天前伊朗导弹袭击“海岛城”号油轮的回应；这艘改挂旗帜的科威特油轮当时停泊在科威特近海。袭击发生在“坚定意志”行动期间，后者旨在两伊战争中保护科威特航运。

en.s: From October 1988 to September 1994 the British government banned broadcasts of the voices of representatives from Sinn Féin and ten other Irish republican and loyalist groups on television and radio in the United Kingdom. The restrictions, announced by the Home Secretary, Douglas Hurd, on 19 October 1988, followed a heightened period of violence in the course of the Troubles, and reflected the UK government's belief in a need to prevent these groups from using the media for political advantage.

Ross-Edwards had represented Shepparton since the seat was re-established in 1967, and served as the leader of the Victorian National Party (previously known as the Country Party) from 1970 until 1988.

en.s: Benazir Bhutto (21 June 1953 – 27 December 2007) was a Pakistani stateswoman who twice served as the Prime Minister of Pakistan from 1988 to 1990 and again from 1993 to 1996. She was the first woman elected to head a democratic government in a Muslim-majority country. Ideologically a liberal and a secularist, she chaired the Pakistan People's Party (PPP) from 1982 until her assassination in 2007.

zh.t: 贝娜齐尔·布托就任总理
zh.s: 贝娜齐尔·布托生于1953年6月21日，卒于2007年12月27日，是巴基斯坦政治家，曾于1988年至1990年及1993年至1996年两度担任巴基斯坦总理。她是穆斯林占多数的国家中，首位经选举产生的女性民主政府首脑。她主张自由主义和世俗主义，自1982年起担任巴基斯坦人民党（PPP）主席，直至2007年遭暗杀。

en.s: The 2nd Alberta Senate nominee election was held in Alberta, Canada, on October 19, 1998, in conjunction with the Alberta Municipal Elections. It was held to elect Alberta's candidates for appointment to the Canadian Senate. In the first senate election held in 1989, Prime Minister Brian Mulroney had promised to advise the Governor General to appoint the winner of the election. In 1998, Prime Minister Jean Chrétien advised Governor General Roméo LeBlanc to appoint two senators for Alberta shortly before the vote. Despite these appointments, two senator nominees were selected in a block vote, that was broken down along municipal electoral districts instead of provincial electoral districts.

zh.t: 1998年艾伯塔省参议员提名人选举
zh.s: 加拿大艾伯塔省第二届参议员提名人选举于1998年10月19日举行，与该省市政选举同步进行，目的是选出供任命为加拿大参议员的艾伯塔省人选。在1989年的首次此类选举中，总理布赖恩·马尔罗尼曾承诺建议总督任命获胜者。1998年，总理让·克雷蒂安在投票前不久，建议总督罗密欧·勒布朗为艾伯塔省任命两名参议员。尽管已有这些任命，选举仍通过全票制选出两名参议员提名人；投票按市政选区而非省议会选区组织。

en.s: The 1998 Calgary municipal election was held on October 19, 1998, to elect a Mayor and 14 Aldermen to Calgary City Council. In addition to the city council election, trustees to the Calgary Board of Education, Calgary Catholic School District, two plebiscites and the Alberta Senate nominee election. en.s: Taboo Tuesday (2004) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) and presented by AT&T which took place on October 19, 2004 at the Bradley Center in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. en.t: Hurricane Wilma (pictured) became the most intense Atlantic hurricane on record with a minimum atmospheric pressure of 882 mbar (26.05 inHg)
en.s: Hurricane Wilma was the most intense tropical cyclone in the Atlantic basin and the second-most intense tropical cyclone in the Western Hemisphere, both based on barometric pressure, after Hurricane Patricia in 2015. Wilma's rapid intensification led to a 24-hour pressure drop of 97 mbar (2.9 inHg), setting a new basin record. At its peak, Hurricane Wilma's eye contracted to a record minimum diameter of 2.3 mi (3.7 km).

zh.t: 飓风威尔玛的最低气压降至882毫巴（26.05英寸汞柱），成为大西洋有记录以来最强的飓风
zh.s: 按气压衡量，飓风威尔玛是大西洋盆地最强的热带气旋，也是西半球第二强的热带气旋，仅次于2015年的飓风帕特里夏。威尔玛迅速增强，气压在24小时内下降97毫巴（2.9英寸汞柱），刷新了该盆地的纪录。达到巅峰强度时，威尔玛的风眼收缩至创纪录的最小直径2.3英里（3.7公里）。

en.s: Malice in the Palace was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event that was filmed on October 19, 2007 at the Cow Palace in Daly City, California. en.s: The Canadian federal election, 2015 (formally the 42nd general election) was held on October 19, 2015, to elect members to the House of Commons of the 42nd Canadian Parliament. The writs of election for the 2015 election were issued by Governor General David Johnston on August 2. The ensuing campaign was one of the longest in Canadian history. It was also the first time since the 1979 election that a Prime Minister strove to remain in office into a fourth consecutive parliament. The Liberal Party, led by Justin Trudeau, won 184 seats, allowing it to form a majority government with Trudeau becoming the next Prime Minister.
